data.title: Finding the Ten in Teen Numbers
data.description: Discover the hidden ten inside teen numbers by coloring ten counters yellow.

challenges.hint: Count them out one at a time and stop at ten.
challenges.narration: Here is a mixed-up group. Find the ten hiding inside it.
challenges.instruction: Here are 11 counters. Turn 10 of them yellow!
